description: This file implements the AzureBlobGrainStorage class for Orleans, providing methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state data in Azure Blob Storage, along with initialization logic and detailed logging.

classes.name: AzureBlobGrainStorage
classes.description: A storage provider class for managing grain state in Azure Blob Storage, supporting read, write, clear, and init operations with detailed logging and error handling.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the grain state data from Azure Blob Storage and updates the grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the grain state data to Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Deletes or clears the grain state data from Azure Blob Storage based on configuration.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to the silo lifecycle events for initialization.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Performs initialization, including creating the Azure Blob client and container factory.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state data into BinaryData using configured serializer.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes BinaryData into grain state data using configured serializer.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Uses the activator provider to create new instances of grain state objects.
